integrity: Complete proof and explicit exact-rational diagnostic code included. The proof, not finite tests, establishes the universal result; publication priority is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Finite sharp modulus only for nonnegative real signals on finite unweighted stars, counting measure, centered maximal ball averages, and unweighted edge total variation. Signed standard maximal function has infinite two-input seminorm modulus. No extension to weighted or other graph families; not all maximizing pairs classified.
title: Sharp two-input graph-variation stability of the centered maximal operator on stars
